items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation's ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months, underperforming the Zacks Chemical - Diversified industry decline of 7.8% and the S&P 500's 13.9% increase. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on ALB stock.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB), the world's largest lithium supplier, reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike, the union announced. The proposed agreement must be ratified through a member vote.

items.headline: Albemarle Names BHP Executive Ragnar Udd as Next CEO
items.snippet: The appointment brings a senior mining executive with experience across major commodity markets into Albemarle at a consequential point for the global lithium industry. Albemarle's 2026 outlook remains highly sensitive to lithium prices.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher, according to a Bloomberg report. Albemarle (ALB) noted that global lithium demand grew 45% through May this year, significantly outstripping supply.
